title: Whole Open Papery Calyx and Globose Berry Physalis
description: One wholly newly authored Physalis-like fruit assembly: a whole uncut orange-yellow globose berry remains seated inside its complete papery calyx, whose five pointed lobes are deliberately opened and bent back to reveal it. The calyx is one continuous thin closed shell with an attached basal cup, five broad folded panels, true outer clefts and a short whole curved pedicel. Its muted straw surfaces carry only a few real fold ridges and solid colour bands, not image textures. All calyx profiles, shared shell topology, berry dimensions and stalk path are new, not an extracted strawberry fruit, recoloured pomegranate, earthstar ray-count change or reused leaf kit. One complete botanical fruit prop, zero scenes, approximately seven-centimetre opened display width and two-centimetre berry. The opened pose and finite basal underside are explicit display conventions: natural inflated closed husk, paper translucency, microscopic venation, hairs, internal seeds, growth and exact species identification are not reconstructed. This is not a whole living plant or a food-safety/edibility, medicinal, physical-stability, rig or animation claim.
